description: Defines the Report entity class for ORM mapping, representing reports in the HRM system with properties like id, name, report group, filter usage, and type.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Entity class mapped to the 'ohrm_report' table, representing report records with properties and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates a ReportGroup entity with this report.

methods.name: isUseFilterField
methods.description: Checks if the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: setUseFilterField
methods.description: Sets whether the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the report, if set.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the report.
